hero.name: Courtney Thomas
hero.positioning: Stories for the chapters we survive.
hero.hook: Kathryn wakes in the dark, wrists bound, and learns the man holding the key is not the worst thing looking for her.
hero.ctaPrimaryAria: Buy The Price of Choosing You

startHere.heading: Two ways in
startHere.lede: Some readers come for the novels. Some come for a short page to read before the day begins. Start wherever you are.

cards.title: The Price of Choosing You
cards.body: Survival and sacrifice. Kathryn wakes in chains and learns she is being held against something worse.

cards.title: 365 Days of Grace
cards.body: Early alarms, bedtime guilt, and the grace that meets a working mother in the middle of an ordinary day.

series.heading: The Price Series
series.lede: Three novels about Kathryn and Kalem: survival, the cost of freedom, and what is worth keeping after the truth is told.
series.orderNote: Start with Book One, because each book asks a question that only becomes real once the one before it has been answered.

standalone.heading: Essays and devotionals
standalone.lede: Purpose, self-worth, and working motherhood, written from seasons Courtney has lived through herself.
standalone.childrenLede: A story for children who have experienced loss, and for the families who support them.

journal.heading: Notes from the page
journal.lede: Short essays on the work behind the books: surviving into story, gardens of purpose, ordinary grace, and what love leaves behind.

newsletter.heading: Reader notes
newsletter.promise: A letter when there is something to say: a new book, a journal post, a word for a hard week. A few times a year, not more. Leave whenever you like.
newsletter.privacyNote: Your name and email stay with Courtney. See the privacy page.
newsletter.leadMagnetLine: A short sample from the books comes with your first letter.

contact.heading: Write to Courtney
contact.lede: For book clubs, readings, and notes from readers.
contact.successNote: Thank you. Your note is on its way to Courtney.
contact.errorNote: That didn't send. Please try again or email later.

footer.tagline: Stories for the chapters we survive.
